_readme: Naming system: [Collection] [Design] [Garment], [Print]. Collection prefix is set by build-data.mjs from the product's primary collection. 'designs' is keyed by the legacy design name (legacy name minus the garment suffix and print in brackets). 'products' overrides by slug. Every story line is a DRAFT for team approval and describes only what is visible on the product, or a fact from brief section 3.

33 RPM.name: 33 RPM
33 RPM.story: The two letters spun into rings, like a record at 33 RPM.
33 RPM.note: Kept: most people read 33 RPM as a record in one look.

3DEF.name: 3D Letters
3DEF.story: E and F built as solid blocks in four colors, as if cut from wood.

Abracadabra Black Cats.name: Cat Letters
Abracadabra Black Cats.story: Two cats, drawn in one line, standing in for the E and the F.
Abracadabra Black Cats.note: 'Abracadabra' doesn't describe the shirt. The cats do.

Abracadabra White Cats.name: Cat Letters
Abracadabra White Cats.story: Two cats, drawn in one line, standing in for the E and the F.
Abracadabra White Cats.note: Same design as Black Cats, so merged into one design name.

Argyla.name: Bike Poster
Argyla.story: A red bike, a robot in an EF shirt, and ARGYLE in big black type.
Argyla.note: 'Argyla' looks like a typo of Argyle.

Argyle Bros..name: Pixel Walk
Argyle Bros..story: Argyle in pixel art, cap on, mid-stride.
Argyle Bros..note: 'Bros.' needs context a stranger doesn't have.

Balloon.name: Balloon Letters
Balloon.story: EF blown up like party balloons, in candy colors.
Balloon.note: Clarified: it's the letters that are balloons.

Boss.name: Collage
Boss.story: Shapes, stripes and a little blue tag, all arranged around a striped EF.

Boss Tee.name: Collage
Boss Tee.story: Shapes, stripes and a little blue tag, all arranged around a striped EF.
Boss Tee.note: 'Boss Tee' doubled the garment word. Merged with the Boss hoodie.

Boxed.name: Striped Blocks
Boxed.story: The E and the F reduced to two blocks of stripes.

Breakout.name: Patchwork
Breakout.story: EF stitched together from tiles of pattern and type.

Côte d’Azur.name: Côte d’Azur Map
Côte d’Azur.story: A street map of the Côte d’Azur, in blues.
Côte d’Azur.note: Added 'Map' so it reads in one go.

Dimensions.name: Dimensions
Dimensions.story: A striped EF that looks like it’s coming off the shirt.

Doodle.name: Education First Doodle
Doodle.story: EDUCATION and FIRST, with marker scribbles in between.

EF Berger King.name: Chunky Letters
EF Berger King.story: A fat, shiny, 3D ef in red and gold.
EF Berger King.note: Fast-food parody. Unclear to strangers and a trademark risk. Dropped.

EF Japan.name: Japan
EF Japan.story: A small chest print: EF set vertically, in red, white and blue.
EF Japan.note: Kept the place, dropped the doubled EF.

EFRAME.name: Frame
EFRAME.story: A blocky EF wrapped in black bars and a thin frame.

Evolution.name: Logo Evolution
Evolution.story: Three EF logos in a row, oldest to newest.

FE Black.name: Mascot
FE Black.story: The FE character, drawn in one line, mid-run with a bag.
FE Black.note: Split the print color out of the design name.

FE White.name: Mascot
FE White.story: The FE character, drawn in one line, mid-run with a bag.
FE White.note: Split the print color out of the design name.

FE Red.name: Mascot
FE Red.story: The FE character, drawn in one line, mid-run with a bag.
FE Red.note: Split the print color out of the design name.

First Born.name: Shadow Letters
First Born.story: A tall EF with a striped shadow in red, orange and yellow.
First Born.note: 'First Born' implies a history fact we can't source.

Flag Face.name: Flag Face
Flag Face.story: Flags in a line, drawn into a face beside the EF. Signed by Paul Rand.
Flag Face.note: Kept: the Rand story uses this name.

Flow.name: Flow
Flow.story: Two sets of curved stripes that make an E and an F.

Greenland.name: Green Map
Greenland.story: A city map in greens, with EF hidden in the streets.

Icing.name: Swirl
Icing.story: EF spun into thin colored rings.

IloveFE.name: Heart
IloveFE.story: I ♥ and the FE character, in red and blue.
IloveFE.note: Kept the joke, fixed the spacing.

Japan Cup 2024.name: Japan Cup 2024
Japan Cup 2024.story: A robot, a crocodile and a skyline, in red, with JAPAN CUP across the bottom.
Japan Cup 2024.note: Kept: it's what the print says.

Joels Candy Store.name: Candy Rings
Joels Candy Store.story: EF in bright rings, like the stripes on hard candy.
Joels Candy Store.note: Inside joke about a person we can't name.

Landscapef.name: Mountain Badge
Landscapef.story: A small arched badge: mountains, trees and EF at the top.

London Bus.name: London Bus
London Bus.story: A double-decker with EF on the side, on a yellow ground.

Lucerne.name: Lucerne
Lucerne.story: EF filled with a collage of pattern and type.

Masterpiece.name: Paint Splash
Masterpiece.story: A pink beast on a bike, splattered on with paint drips.

My First Hoodie.name: Striped EF
My First Hoodie.story: The EF in thick stripes, small on the chest.
My First Hoodie.note: 'My First Hoodie' doesn't describe the design.

My First Tshirt.name: Striped EF
My First Tshirt.story: The EF in thick stripes, big on the chest.
My First Tshirt.note: 'My First Tshirt' doubled the garment word.

New Wave.name: New Wave
New Wave.story: A lowercase ef on a circle and triangle, in 80s pastels.

No Signal.name: No Signal
No Signal.story: EF on a TV test card, timestamp and color bars included.

Orange County.name: Orange County Map
Orange County.story: A street map of Orange County, in oranges and reds.

Paintbrush.name: Brushstroke
Paintbrush.story: EF painted in one ribbon of color.

Part Tickles.name: Particles
Part Tickles.story: Pieces of EF scattered like a chart: a dot, a spiral, the number 65.
Part Tickles.note: Pun too hard to read on first look.

Paul Rand Option 1.name: Option 1
Paul Rand Option 1.story: One of the alternate EF logos Paul Rand drew for EF: red and blue stripes.
Paul Rand Option 1.note: Option numbering kept so the product matches the Rand story.

Paul Rand Option 2.name: Option 2
Paul Rand Option 2.story: One of Rand’s alternate EF logos: italic letters filled with a pattern of type.

Paul Rand Option 3.name: Option 3
Paul Rand Option 3.story: One of Rand’s alternate EF logos: EF inside a circle of cut letters.

Pink Different 2026.name: Pink Rings
Pink Different 2026.story: EF in pink, orange and blue rings.

Pixel.name: Pixel Planet
Pixel.story: A pixel Earth with an EF flag planted on top.

Planet.name: Planet
Planet.story: EDUCATION FIRST around a globe with a pink ring.

Polka.name: Bike
Polka.story: Argyle on a racing bike in a polka-dot jersey.
Polka.note: Polka alone doesn't say crocodile on a bike.

Pyxel.name: Pixel Face
Pyxel.story: Argyle’s head in pixel art, big eyes, small teeth.

Retro Horizon.name: Horizon
Retro Horizon.story: A sunset in stripes, framed like an old ticket, with SINCE repeated down the side.

Rialto Blue.name: Rialto
Rialto Blue.story: A bold EF over a slanted stripe of color.

Rialto Red.name: Rialto
Rialto Red.story: A bold EF over a slanted stripe of color.

Rings of Color.name: Rings of Color
Rings of Color.story: EF in rings of every color.

Signal.name: Wave Letters
Signal.story: EF in soft green and pink waves.

SmilEF.name: Smiley
SmilEF.story: A hand-drawn smiley whose face is E and F.

So Rainbow.name: Rainbow
So Rainbow.story: A striped EF in a rainbow fade.

Stayin' Alive.name: Disco
Stayin' Alive.story: A slanted ef, like the lettering on an old record sleeve.
Stayin' Alive.note: Song reference doesn't describe the shirt.

Stripes.name: Stripes
Stripes.story: E and F made only of pink and navy bars.

Teegar.name: Tiger
Teegar.story: An orange tiger wearing an EF shirt.

Utilitarian.name: Utility
Utilitarian.story: EF*, ACADEMIC / ADVENTURE, in clean workwear type.

Versargyle.name: Sunglasses
Versargyle.story: Argyle in sunglasses and a pink argyle cap.
Versargyle.note: Fashion-house pun; not clear to everyone.

WTEF.name: Paper Cutout
WTEF.story: EF built from overlapping cut-paper shapes in red, yellow, green and blue.
WTEF.note: WTF joke. Not for a family store.

Pi-F.name: Circles
Pi-F.story: Thin circles that overlap until they almost make an E and an F.

so-rainbow-hat.story: The rainbow EF, small on the front.

rings-of-color-hat.story: EF in rings of every color, small on the front.

classic-ef-hat.story: Just the EF, small, on the side.

ef-academy-cap-1.story: The EF Academy crest, on a dark cap.

ef-academy-cap-2.story: The EF Academy crest, on a light cap.

ef-academy-cap-3.story: EF ACADEMY and the crest, on a dark cap.

ef-academy-cap-4.story: EF ACADEMY and the crest, on a light cap.

ef-academy-pullover-hoodie-1.story: EF ACADEMY over the crest, small on the chest.

ef-academy-pullover-hoodie-2.story: Only the crest, small on the chest.

ef-academy-pullover-hoodie-3.story: EF ACADEMY over the crest, small on the chest.

ef-academy-casual-tee-1.story: EF ACADEMY in an arch, college style.

ef-academy-casual-tee-3.story: The crest and EF ACADEMY on one line.

doodle-light-print-casual-tee-2.story: EDUCATION and FIRST, with marker scribbles in between.
doodle-light-print-casual-tee-2.note: VERIFY: live store calls this 'Light Print', but it only comes in light garments, like the Dark Print boxy tee. Looks mislabeled on store.ef.com.
